semantic_types.rule: random application-local identifier; never derived from a Microsoft or user identity
strict typed locator validated before application-level authenticated encryption
purpose-separated keyed digest with fixed algorithm and length; never reversible encoding
versioned closed code set with unknown values rejected
boolean only
integer with field-specific closed bounds
canonical UTC instant used only for the named operational purpose
bounded duration used only for the named operational purpose
validated block ordinal and Unicode scalar boundary range; no captured text
bounded non-content implementation or policy version label
typed temporal instant/date/range/event reference encrypted after validation; never the source phrase
value explicitly authored by the user for an enumerated setting key and encrypted after per-key validation
opaque reference to an operating-system-protected secret; never secret material
bounded set or ordered list of application-local references
bounded aggregate count without person, client, message, task, or exact-event dimensions
algorithm-specific fixed-length nonce or authentication tag; permitted only in the persistence envelope
bounded authenticated-encryption output for one already validated logical record; permitted only in the persistence envelope
user-authored local clock time or recurring schedule; exact serialized form and bounds require ADR-005 before use
user-selected IANA or Windows timezone catalog identifier; exact accepted catalog requires ADR-005 before use
non-event rolling-window bucket with no exact activity timestamp; exact serialized form requires ADR-005 before use

retention_policies.rule: retain until account disconnect or explicit local account deletion
retain until the collection leaves configured scope or account disconnects
configured history window of 1 through 365 days plus exactly 15 days; an active reference pins only required records

retain only the required encrypted message-observation and content-free health fields while retry dismiss or recovery remains unresolved; success dismissal or recovery returns the observation to observation-window retention and deletes it immediately when that window has elapsed; disconnect immediately deletes the local observation and related health record regardless of age with zero Graph mutations
candidate or open loop lineage until terminal resolution, explicit user deletion, or disconnect
default 30 days after terminal state; configurable integer from 0 through 365 days
completed operation entries for exactly 90 days
pending or ambiguous operation until reconciled or explicitly abandoned

unresolved health state only until retry success, dismissal, recovery completion, or disconnect; resolution atomically deletes the job_health record before the related observation returns to ordinary retention
until changed, explicitly deleted, reset where supported, or disconnect
inherits the exact retention and deletion policy of the enclosed validated logical record

operation_policies.rule: logical deletion of application-controlled records with reference-aware cleanup; zero Graph mutations and no Microsoft artifact deletion
best-effort database compaction and safe key retirement with no physical-erasure guarantee
reset touches only aggregate product counters
reset or replacement touches only the named user setting
local cleanup follows explicit leave, detach, or individual-review choices and never bulk-deletes Microsoft artifacts
product-state and metric export are unavailable in the MVP and require a new privacy decision
diagnostic export remains unavailable until a separate exact content-free schema, ADR-012, G-PRIV, G-RELEASE, and G-SEC-AUDIT pass

cross_record_invariants.rule: typed logical records are validated immediately before encryption and immediately after decryption or migration

unknown manifest record, field, source variant, metadata bag, extension bag, generic string, generic bytes, or generic map is rejected; runtime enum, value, and version schemas approve no values until ADR-005 and the dependent domain ADR define exact catalogs and bounds
email_evidence origin requires valid email evidence and never an authoritative user-authored artifact source
calendar_invitation origin requires a calendar invitation source and remains unavailable until G-CAL, G-MAIL, and G-PRIV
user_authored_microsoft_artifact origin requires exactly one authoritative artifact source and user_authoritative title, body, and due ownership
model or system output cannot overwrite authoritative user-authored artifact title, body, or due field state
artifact deletion or inaccessibility produces source unavailable without text fallback, fabricated closure, or automatic terminal transition
reminder completion or deletion never closes an email or invitation loop
state deletion, reset, retention, disconnect, and export operations produce zero Graph mutations and never bulk-delete Microsoft artifacts
tokens, provider keys, encryption keys, HMAC keys, and pairing secrets are excluded and remain governed by ADR-005 or ADR-010
no product-state or metric export exists in the MVP; diagnostic export requires a separately approved exact content-free schema and named gates

logical deletion and best-effort compaction or key retirement never claim physical erasure from SSD history, OS paging, backups, snapshots, endpoint security, administrator access, or platform crashes

retry success dismissal or recovery atomically deletes the related job_health record before returning the message_observation to ordinary retention; disconnect atomically deletes both local records; a quarantine_ref never dangles and cleanup performs zero Graph mutations
